tools.name: project_info
tools.description: Get a project's public root index: every resource with record counts and URLs, custom routes, auth mode, and export links (openapi.json, types.ts, postman.json, db.json, GraphQL). No adminKey needed. Try project "demo" for the shared public playground.

tools.name: write_record
tools.description: Create, update, or delete records in a mock resource. Writes persist (unlike JSONPlaceholder/FakeStoreAPI). POST creates (auto-id), PUT replaces, PATCH merges, DELETE removes. id required for PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_project, import_data, project_info, share_project, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status, image_url · Private data: import_data, fork_project, add_resource, project_info, query_records, write_record, delete_project, snapshots, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status, image_url · Public sink: create_project, import_data, add_resource, write_record, generate_fake_data, inspect_requests, share_project, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status · Destructive: create_project, fork_project, write_record, inspect_requests, delete_project, snapshots, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status, image_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_project, import_data, project_info, share_project, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status, image_url · Private data: import_data, fork_project, add_resource, project_info, query_records, write_record, delete_project, snapshots, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status, image_url · Public sink: create_project, import_data, add_resource, write_record, generate_fake_data, inspect_requests, share_project, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status · Destructive: create_project, fork_project, write_record, inspect_requests, delete_project, snapshots, verdict, uptime_monitor, heartbeat, watch_service_status, image_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
